name: @xyb-community/cidp-workbench
description: 本机优先的慢性炎性脱髓鞘性多发性神经根神经病（CIDP）患者工作台：IVIG 周期输注记录、复发—缓解时间线、肌力与残疾自记口径（医生原文）、神经电生理复查档案、费用与医保负担记录、复诊问题清单

scripts.check: node --check dsh/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && node scripts/check-workbench-package.mjs . && node scripts/check-host-contract.mjs && node scripts/smoke-activate.mjs && node scripts/check-probe-coverage.mjs && node scripts/check-version-literal.mjs && node scripts/check-agent-pane-contract.mjs . && node scripts/check-static-refs.mjs && node scripts/check-choice-limit.mjs && node scripts/check-assertion-strength.mjs && node scripts/check-derivative-leftovers.mjs . && node scripts/check-trial-snapshot.mjs . --if-present && node scripts/check-schema-words.mjs . && node scripts/check-primer-links.mjs && node scripts/build-version.mjs --check && node scripts/build-client.mjs --check && node scripts/migrate-public.mjs --check && node scripts/check-public-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-wording.mjs . && node scripts/check-ui-parity.mjs && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/build-version.mjs && node scripts/build-client.mjs && node scripts/migrate-public.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run test && npm run audit
